objective: Validate three explicitly defined M-Lab multi-OD burst load tiers and produce an auditable load table through one formally authorized six-cell consistency matrix; final E0 threshold selection remains a post-run decision.
context: This is a load-contract and analysis-chain validation step, not an algorithm comparison.
Each load tier has two identical non-learning cells with the same trace seed and resolved demand override; the paired difference must be zero if the formal chain is deterministic.

The three values are base offered rates before the declared burst. With a 20 s horizon, an 8 s burst starting at 8 s and multiplier 2, the integrated time-average targets are 70, 140 and 280 Mbps for base rates 50, 100 and 200 Mbps.
The result provides duplicate-consistency and raw load evidence for later E0 selection; it does not by itself establish a universal threshold, a cross-tier causal response, or a paper effect.
deliverables: A compiled and independently reviewed six-cell matrix
Receipt-verified VM outputs for all three load pairs
A persisted V2 paired analysis and a load-tier evidence table with source, endpoint, burst, offered-bit and fate checks
cannot_claim: A universal or final E0 load threshold
Q0 optimality or a paper-ready statistical conclusion
acceptance: Matrix identity, exact demand intervention path and pair membership pass independent cold review.
All six cells complete naturally on one clean deployed SHA with conservation and acceptance true.
V2 analysis recomputes delivery_rate for all three duplicate pairs and persists a VERIFIED analysis.

For every tier, the post-run evidence table re-derives the resolved base rate, integrated burst-average target, M-Lab source and endpoint-selection identity, burst transform, offered bits, fates, wall time and raw metric validation from immutable artifacts.
